mkdir app-project
cd app-project
exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix app- --board-name 'Default board'
# Git owns the pre-existing template, so compare only Cardamom's complete appended entries.
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
exec sh -c 'tail -n 2 .git/info/exclude >appended-exclude.txt'
cmp appended-exclude.txt $WORK/golden/appended-exclude.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: app-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

# Info emits typed store information through the requested output mode.
exec card --json info
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/info.json

# Init JSON preserves the complete public result while using the bootstrap service.
exec card --json init json-project --prefix json- --board-name 'Default board'
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/init.json

# Quiet suppresses notices while preserving command results and state changes.
exec card --quiet create 'Quiet issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create.txt
exec card -q close app-1
! stdout .
exec card --json show app-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/show-closed.json
